label: Custodial Interrogation Was Not Recorded (Stephan)
motion_heading: The Defendant's Statements Must Be Suppressed Because the Custodial Interrogation Was Not Recorded

review_conditions.display_note: You aren't sure yet whether your client was in custody. This section was drafted anyway; pin down whether your client was under arrest or restrained like an arrest (handcuffs, locked car, told not free to leave) before filing, or cut this section.

You aren't sure yet whether the questioning was recorded. This section was drafted anyway; request every recording from every officer and device before filing, or cut this section.

rule_statements.text: A custodial interrogation conducted in a place of detention must be electronically recorded when recording is feasible.
An unexcused failure to record requires suppression of the unrecorded statements.

practice_notes: Ask for all recordings, including from other devices and officers, and for any explanation of why recording wasn't done — the feasibility of recording is the likely battleground.
